versions.subject: Two new Sysmon rules for Office Macro/PS detection
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine: 
        - '*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadstring(*'
        - '*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadfile(*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\powershell.exe" CommandLine IN ("*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadstring(*", "*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadfile(*")
